summary.text: Eric Tilleman is a Republican state representative from Montana who has represented House District 23 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former high school agriculture and FFA teacher and volunteer fire chief, he serves on the House State Administration, House Education, and Agriculture committees.

paragraphs.text: Eric Tilleman's career experience includes working as a high school agriculture FFA teacher and as a volunteer fire chief.
He has also served as the Rural Fire Council President.
Tilleman defeated Sandor Hopkins and Kevin Leatherbarrow in the November 5, 2024 general election and assumed office on January 6, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the House State Administration, House Education, and Agriculture committees.
